scope: PR metadata, commit comparisons against main and target, selected patches and source files. Updated with audit findings: PR #97 abandonment root cause, -s ours merge discovery, workflow capacity resolution via PR #151, AGENTS.md runner isolation boundary enforcement, and full 26 PR reconciliation.
warning: Commit distances describe ancestry only. They do not measure missing features, retained code, or acceptance status. All 26 PR merges into target were executed using 'git merge -s ours', introducing zero file changes; ancestry alone is not proof of code restoration.

audit_findings.empty_ours_merges_discovery: All 26 PR merges on consolidate/all-work-clean-2026-10-14 (commits 1762a73609 through ca69bdb108) were executed using 'git merge -s ours'. For commit 89f5d4bf19 (merging PR #97), git diff with its parent is empty (0 files changed, 0 insertions, 0 deletions). The entire 78-crate modular tree from PR #97 was discarded. The target tree remained 100% on the monolithic 10-crate layout. Git ancestry checks report true solely due to these empty merge commits, creating an ancestry illusion without actual code presence.
audit_findings.pr97_abandonment_root_cause: PR #97 (121138a959) split the repository into 78 fine-grained crates. Generating CI workflows for 78 crates exceeded GitHub's 500 KB limit ('workflow_too_large') and the orchestrator's 512 KiB matrix byte budget. It also stalled on external blockers (Ubuntu 26.04 container image unavailable on GHCR, ChainArgos ScaleSet 3 offline, DCO trailer failures on 9 older commits) and platform compilation issues on macOS (mkfifoat in safe_read/tests.rs). Stalled at v0.1.7, it was closed and later absorbed via empty -s ours merge 89f5d4bf19.
audit_findings.technical_viability_via_pr151_pr110: PR #110 (YAML anchor/alias compaction via yaml_share.rs) and PR #151 (matrix budget raised to 4 MiB + composite-action fallback for wide workspaces via large_crate_composite.rs) completely eliminate the workflow size deadlock. Large crate obligations are automatically extracted to .github/actions/crate-obligations-*, allowing 78+ crates to generate workflows well under the 500 KB ceiling with full test coverage.
audit_findings.runner_boundary_compliance: PR #97 incorrectly embedded 10 runner crates (crates/tools/velnor-runner-*) into the root generator workspace. Under AGENTS.md, V1 is strictly a CI workflow generator. Runner behavior is forbidden in generator crates. Runner code must live exclusively in nested workspace crates/velnor-runner (exclude = ['crates/velnor-runner']), governed by docs/proposed/macos-scaleset-runner.md.
audit_findings.scope_reconciliation_17_vs_26: The original review tracked 17 active PRs (#77–#151). The user requested 26 PRs (#12, #13, #25, #28, #29, #30, #38, #56, #65, #77, #94, #95, #97, #98, #109, #110, #114, #124, #125, #126, #127, #128, #143, #144, #150, #151). The 9 earlier PRs (#12–#65) were historical foundation PRs merged via -s ours; their functional changes were already incorporated into main prior to v0.1.8, or superseded by native MBX/Mise toolchain updates. All 26 PRs are now fully accounted for.

crate_topology.original_proposal: Broad instruction to restore useful crate splits from PR #97, but lacked concrete subcrate mapping and retained monolithic crate structures in review.
crate_topology.user_goal: Full Granular Port of generator crates into domain groups (adapters, apps, core, services, tools). Monolithic crates split into single-responsibility crates to optimize build times and leaf recompilation.

runner_isolation.original_proposal: Conflated runner daemon implementation, AppArmor checks, and capacity transactions into PR #97 generator workspace scope (lines 338-366).
runner_isolation.user_goal: Strict isolation per AGENTS.md. Generator workspace remains pure V1 workflow generator. Runner crates reside strictly in nested crates/velnor-runner (exclude = ['crates/velnor-runner']).

ancestry_vs_real_code.original_proposal: Treated PRs as 'already in history' of target, not emphasizing that commit 89f5d4bf19 was an empty -s ours merge that discarded the 78-crate tree.
ancestry_vs_real_code.user_goal: Replaces the empty -s ours merge state with actual ported code and passing tests, rejecting 'ancestry-only' completion.

workflow_capacity.original_proposal: Preserved PR #110 and PR #151 independently, without identifying them as the missing prerequisite that unlocks PR #97's viability.
workflow_capacity.user_goal: Directly leverages PR #110 text compaction and PR #151 composite-action fallback to generate compliant, green workflows for the 78+ crate workspace.

modern_features.user_goal: Explicit preservation specifications: OpenTofu 1.13.1 parser/grammar/proposal in adapters/tofu-core, PR #144 typed task execution in orchestrator/workflow, and v0.1.8 release metadata.

pr_accounting.original_proposal: Reviewed only 17 PRs (#77–#151), omitting earlier historical PRs from documentation.
pr_accounting.user_goal: Complete accounting of all 26 requested PRs (#12–#151), documenting their merge commits, trees, and dispositions.
